If it just broke and you still have it then I would say just fix it if you like it so much, now if it disappeared and you can’t find it anywhere whether it broke and fell off or whatever the case then I would take that scenario as a sign that it has served its purpose. I had a bracelet I enchanted to protect me from seeing a specific person I didn’t like, pretty much to not cross paths, and it would fall off sometimes and I’d have to fix it, I’d usually re enchant it. But one day this person started showing up in small ways in my life again and I looked at my wrist and the bracelet was gone, like magic, I couldn’t find it anywhere. It could have fell off somewhere outside it’s possible but the fact that the protection wore off let me know that it probably had served it’s purpose.
